sentences.text_target: It is Saturday morning.
sentences.text_native: C'est samedi matin.

sentences.text_target: Tom wakes up early today.
sentences.text_native: Tom se réveille tôt aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He is very hungry.
sentences.text_native: Il a très faim.

sentences.text_target: He goes into the kitchen.
sentences.text_native: Il va dans la cuisine.

sentences.text_target: He opens the fridge.
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre le frigo.

sentences.text_target: The fridge is completely empty.
sentences.text_native: Le frigo est complètement vide.

sentences.text_target: He needs food for the week.
sentences.text_native: Il a besoin de nourriture pour la semaine.

sentences.text_target: Tom takes his jacket and keys.
sentences.text_native: Tom prend sa veste et ses clés.

sentences.text_target: He walks out the door.
sentences.text_native: Il franchit la porte.

sentences.text_target: He walks down the street.
sentences.text_native: Il descend la rue en marchant.

sentences.text_target: He arrives at the local supermarket.
sentences.text_native: Il arrive au supermarché du coin.

sentences.text_target: He takes a metal shopping cart.
sentences.text_native: Il prend un caddie en métal.

sentences.text_target: He pushes the cart inside.
sentences.text_native: Il pousse le caddie à l'intérieur.

sentences.text_target: He enters the first aisle.
sentences.text_native: Il entre dans la première allée.

sentences.text_target: The shelves have fresh fruit.
sentences.text_native: Les étagères proposent des fruits frais.

sentences.text_target: He puts bananas and red apples in the cart.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts bəˈnɑːnəz ænd rɛd ˈæplz ɪn ðə kɑːt/
sentences.text_native: Il met des bananes et des pommes rouges dans le caddie.

sentences.text_target: Next, he looks for vegetables.
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il cherche des légumes.

sentences.text_target: He selects nice tomatoes.
sentences.text_native: Il choisit de belles tomates.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the bakery section.
sentences.text_native: Il se dirige vers le rayon boulangerie.

sentences.text_target: He grabs a big loaf of bread.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ɡræbz ə bɪɡ ləʊf ɒv brɛd/
sentences.text_native: Il attrape une grande miche de pain.

sentences.text_target: Then he visits the dairy aisle.
sentences.text_native: Puis il va dans le rayon des produits laitiers.

sentences.text_target: He adds cold milk and cheese to his basket.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ædz kəʊld mɪlk ænd tʃiːz tuː hɪz ˈbɑːskɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il ajoute du lait frais et du fromage à son caddie.

sentences.text_target: He also needs clean water.
sentences.text_native: Il a aussi besoin d'eau potable.

sentences.text_target: He puts a large bottle of water in.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts ə lɑːdʒ ˈbɒtl ɒv ˈwɔːtə ɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il y ajoute une grande bouteille d'eau.

sentences.text_target: Finally, he goes to the cashier.
sentences.text_native: Enfin, il se dirige vers la caisse.

sentences.text_target: He places all his groceries on the desk.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈpleɪsɪz ɔːl hɪz ˈɡrəʊsəriz ɒn ðə kʌʊntə/
sentences.text_native: Il dépose toutes ses courses sur le comptoir.

sentences.text_target: He pays with his bank card.
sentences.text_native: Il paie avec sa carte bancaire.

sentences.text_target: The cashier gives him the receipt.
sentences.text_native: La caissière lui remet le ticket de caisse.

sentences.text_target: Tom puts the items into a strong bag.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm pʊts ði ˈaɪtəmz ˈɪntə ə strɒŋ bæɡ/
sentences.text_native: Tom range ses achats dans un sac solide.

sentences.text_target: He smiles and walks back home.
sentences.text_native: Il sourit et rentre chez lui à pied.
